# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.0.2

- Introduces the refreshed Aqua interface with Light, Dark and System appearance settings.
- Makes USB preparation instructions easy to reopen and explains that stems stay out of rekordbox playlists.
- Fixes completed exports showing “Stopped” instead of “Ready” and restores per-track export progress.
- Improves readable, selectable interface text and keeps export states consistent across Mac and Windows.
- Retains the latest stem engine and USB export fixes, with Apple silicon and Intel installers and signed in-app updates.
- Requires macOS 14 or later, matching the bundled stem engine.
